name: Lying leg raise
notes: Bodyweight leg raise performed on the floor.

guide.setup: Lie on your back with legs straight, hands under the hips or at the sides, and the lower back pressed into the floor.
guide.execution: Raise the legs until they are near vertical, then lower them under control without letting the lower back arch.
guide.cues: Keep the lower back flat. Move slowly. Stop the descent where control ends.
guide.mistakes: Arching the lower back; swinging the legs; bending the knees to cheat; dropping the legs at the bottom.
